name: Brahms in Concert
description: The Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música presents Brahms' Piano Concerto No. 2, an evening of powerful classical music.
longDescription:
The Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música performs Johannes Brahms' Piano Concerto No. 2 in B-flat major, Op. 83. This concert features one of the composer's most substantial works for piano and orchestra, known for its four movements and symphonic scope. The performance is presented by the resident orchestra of Casa da Música, an institution dedicated to classical and contemporary music programming in Porto.

Attendees will experience an evening of classical music within the Sala Suggia at Casa da Música. The concert is scheduled for approximately two hours, including an interval. The Sala Suggia is the main concert hall of the venue, designed with acoustic precision for orchestral performances. The audience typically consists of classical music enthusiasts and concert-goers.

Tickets for "Brahms in Concert" are available from €15. Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), approximately a 5-minute walk. Several bus lines also serve the area. The venue offers accessibility features for visitors with mobility impairments.
